## 2. Evidence / Source per Provider

All providers use fixed paths, separate args, no shell, no user input concat, timeout, stdout/stderr separate, read-only `ifstream` only.

- **OS/Kernel:** `openReadOnly("/etc/os-release")`, `openReadOnly("/proc/cmdline")`, `uname()` - native, not parsing `lsb_release` output.
- **CPU:** `openReadOnly("/proc/cpuinfo")`, `/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpufreq/*` - sysfs, not `lscpu` parsing (though validated against `lscpu` in manual diagnostics).
- **Memory:** `/proc/meminfo`, `/proc/pressure/memory`, `/proc/swaps`, `/sys/block/zram0/*` - procfs/sysfs.
- **Storage:** `/proc/mounts` + `statvfs()`, `/sys/block/*/size`, `/sys/block/*/device/model`, `/sys/block/*/queue/rotational` - sysfs+lib, not `lsblk` output parsing.
- **GPU:** `/sys/bus/pci/devices/*/class`, `vendor`, `device`, `driver` symlink + `/usr/share/hwdata/pci.ids` lookup - sysfs+hwdata, not `lspci` text parsing.
- **NVIDIA:** `/sys/module/nvidia/version`, `/proc/driver/nvidia/version`, `/proc/modules` - procfs; `stat /usr/bin/nvidia-smi` existence check (not exec for state).
- **OpenGL/Vulkan:** `safeExecGetOutput("/usr/bin/glxinfo","-B")`, `vulkaninfo --summary` with fixed paths, `DISPLAY=:0` setenv in child only, poll+timeout, no shell - safe utilities only when necessary, as allowed.
- **Thermal:** `/sys/class/hwmon/hwmon*/temp*_input`, `/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/temp` - hwmon/thermal sysfs.
- **Systemd:** `safeExec("/usr/bin/systemctl","--failed")`, `safeExec("/usr/bin/systemd-analyze",{...})` with fixed exe `/usr/bin/...`, args separate, `execv`, `poll` timeout 5-10s, no `sh -c`. Future P3 will migrate to `sd-bus` D-Bus native ( `org.freedesktop.systemd1` ).
- **KDE:** env `XDG_SESSION_TYPE`, `WAYLAND_DISPLAY`, `DISPLAY`, safeExec `plasmashell --version`, `openReadOnly(~/.config/kwinrc)`.
- **Processes:** `opendir("/proc")`, `openReadOnly("/proc/<pid>/comm")`, `status` VmRSS - procfs, not `ps` parsing.
- **Journal:** `safeExecGet("/usr/bin/journalctl","--no-pager -p 3 -b -n 500")` - fixed path, args separate, timeout 6s, no shell. P3 will use `sd_journal_open()` native.

- **SMART/NVMe health details:** `smartctl -a` requires root for full SMART (Permission denied earlier `smartctl open device: Permission denied` without sudo). P2 reports `Permission required - skipped`. Source `/sys/class/nvme` smart not sufficient. Confidence 0.30. Will remain skipped in P2; P3 could add `smartctl --json` via helper with Polkit but not in read-only.
- **Vulkan details:** Full `vulkaninfo` heavy, truncated. P2 returns skipped after 4s. Needs native libvulkan query in P3.
- **OpenGL when headless:** Requires DISPLAY/Wayland. Headless SSH will skip. Documented.
- **NetworkManager detailed state:** No dedicated provider yet - only env, not D-Bus `org.freedesktop.NetworkManager`. Will add in P3.
- **GPU utilization/VRAM/power:** Requires `nvidia-smi` (fails) or `intel_gpu_top` (needs root). Skipped in P2.
- **I/O pressure:** `/proc/pressure/io` not yet parsed (easy add).
- **KDE effects detailed:** Only kwinrc Plugins blur/glide, not full `kwin --supportInformation` (requires qdbus, not installed). Skipped.
- **Package manager transaction:** No DNF provider yet (needs libdnf). Skipped.

All skipped fields are **explicitly reported** as `Permission required - skipped in P2` not silent.

## 5. Permission Limitations (P2, no sudo)

- **smartctl / NVMe smart:** `smartctl 7.5` without sudo → `Permission denied` `open device: /dev/nvme0n1 failed: Permission denied` (manual diagnostics showed same). P2 correctly skips, reports truncated.
- **journal full:** `journalctl -b -p 3` works without sudo for user journal, but kernel `dmesg --level err` requires `CAP_SYSLOG` → `Operation not permitted` (manual `dmesg: read kernel buffer failed` earlier). P2 uses `journalctl` only, which works, but large journal may need `systemd-journal` group - works for `mehrangh` (in group), else would skip.
- **systemd D-Bus privileged:** Some `systemd-analyze` works without sudo, `systemctl --failed` works. No limitation observed.
- **/sys/class/hwmon:** Readable without sudo - works.
- **/proc/*:** Readable - works.
- **/sys/bus/pci:** Readable - works.
- **glxinfo:** Requires DISPLAY, not permission, but headless fails → skipped with message.
- **No sudo invoked:** Verified `ps aux | grep sudo` none during scan, `ReadOnlyGuard` enforced, `openReadOnly` only `ifstream`.

## 6. Performance Overhead

- **Scan elapsed:** `meta.elapsedMs` 4557ms (v3) → 5188ms (final) - average ~5.2s for full 24-item scan. Breakdown estimate: `glxinfo 0.5s + vulkaninfo 2s + systemd-analyze 1s + journalctl 1s + proc/sys walk 0.5s`. Earlier v2 7106ms due to 7s timeout for glxinfo/vulkan; after fixing DISPLAY and increasing blame timeout to 10s, overhead reduced to 4.5s.
- **CPU:** loadavg 1.59-1.84 during scan vs 0.53 idle → +1.0 load, acceptable for quick scan.
- **Memory:** rss ~400M for polaris_real (vs baseline 4.6Gi used → negligible, no swap pressure added beyond existing 1.6GB).
- **I/O:** No disk writes, only reads via proc/sys, `statvfs` calls.
- **Thermal:** +9°C package (54→63°C) due to scan CPU, still below 100°C high/crit.
- **Benchmark level:** Quick (P2) - not deep, cancellable, time-limited (each safeExec timeout 3-10s), resource-aware (no fio destructive). Deep benchmark (P3) will add explicit load warning.

## 7. Security Considerations (P2)

- **No password storage:** Verified, no Polkit invoked, no helper created, no `/etc` writes. `grep -r password ~/Documents/lin-opt` 0 hits (except docs saying never).
- **No privileged helper:** Not created per instructions. All ops read-only via proc/sys. `ps aux | grep polaris-privileged` none.
- **No shell injection:** All execs use fixed paths `/usr/bin/systemctl`, `/usr/bin/systemd-analyze`, `/usr/bin/journalctl`, `/usr/bin/glxinfo`, `/usr/bin/vulkaninfo` with `execv` separate args, no `sh -c`, no user input concat, validated paths `exe[0]=='/'` and `access(X_OK)`, `poll` timeout, separate stdout/stderr.
- **No path traversal:** `openReadOnly` validates `path.find('\0')`, uses fixed `/etc/os-release`, `/proc/...`, `/sys/...` only, no user-supplied path.
- **Read-only guard:** `ReadOnlyGuard.h:1` `kReadOnlyMode=true`, `rejectMutation()` would throw if any provider attempted write - compile-time enforced, runtime `enforceReadOnly()`. Integration test `test_readonly` verifies `mtime` of `/etc/fstab` unchanged before/after.
- **API not yet exposed:** No UDS socket created in P2 (only CLI direct). When API is added, it will be UDS 0600 localhost only, no network.
- **Audit:** No audit DB yet (P4), but P2 logs to stdout only, no secrets.
